decision.justification: Selected 'weighted weighted by w4' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.9546. Series context: trend strength 0.9436 and seasonal strength 0.21; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.076); 2 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.409.
